title: Pairing refusal is one 150-char paragraph with no single cause
body: One message covered wrong PIN, race running, seats full and profile taken, and named REWIND. Now four codes (RACE_ON, BAD_PIN, FULL, PROFILE_TAKEN) each a line of at most 44 chars; 'message' kept, 'code' added.

title: TV lobby link status was developer-speak (port numbers, exception class)
body: serverStatus fed RaceGame lobby label: 'Opening port 8765...', 'Port busy; retry 3/10', 'Link error: IOException', 'Port unavailable...'. Now 'Phone link ...' lines; detail goes to the log only.

title: Phone re-derives which screen the TV is on from phase+raceMode+sceneryReady
body: controller index.html line 137 maps phase to PRACTICE/GET READY/RACING/PREPARING itself, so garage/career/lobby all read PRACTICE and the vocabulary can drift from the TV. Hud now carries additive 'screen' (LOBBY/GARAGE/CAREER/COUNTDOWN/RACE/RESULTS). Phone should show it.
result: built (link side); phone adoption is a seam
method: LinkTest asserts screen=LOBBY on first hud

title: Phone shows 'PRACTICE' for garage, career menu and lobby alike
body: Seam: controller should render m.screen (or a one-line status) instead of its own ternary; sceneryReady===false -> PREPARING and paused -> TV PAUSED stay phone-side or become a link 'status' field later.

title: Controller does not use refusal 'code'; pairMessage is the only surface
body: Seam: the pair modal could show a picture/state per code (race on -> wait, full -> instruct REWIND) instead of the sentence; today it just prints m.message.

title: Garage/career/car/track hud payloads carry prose the phone prints (messages, lessons, descriptions)
body: Metadata blobs (garage.message, saveStatus, career.message, track.lesson, difficulty.description) are authored in game/core and rendered verbatim on the phone; cutting them is a core/game change plus a controller change.

title: Refusal when the phone is a returning token vs a fresh seat is indistinguishable after a TV reset
body: After REWIND (resetPairing) the old token is silently rejected and the phone gets the PIN error, not 'TV was reset - enter the new PIN'. Needs a RESET code when a presented token matches no slot.
method: read; needs product wording and phone handling

title: Disabled-by-phase commands are dropped silently
body: track/car/garage/career/buy/market messages sent in the wrong phase are ignored with no reply, so a button can appear to do nothing. A short 'notNow' reply (additive) would let the phone show why.

title: /health exposes no PIN-free pairing state for a phone to explain 'both seats taken'
body: Low value now that refusals carry a code; noted so it is not re-filed.

title: Refusal says TV code, not PIN
body: BAD_PIN message now 'Wrong TV code. Check the TV.' to match the phone and TV word. Seam: none (message text only).

title: Lobby link status distinguishes port busy and no Wi-Fi
body: serverStatus is PORT_BUSY after retries on a busy port, NO_WIFI when the LAN address fell back to loopback (refreshed every 10 s). SEAM (TV, game/RaceGame.kt:791): the lobby label shows serverStatus only when !running; show it also when server.noNetwork (new additive property) so No Wi-Fi is visible while the server is up.
result: built (link); TV adoption is a seam

title: Wrong-phase commands answered with notNow
body: track/car/garage/career/careerStart/difficulty/buy/market in a phase that does not take them reply {t:notNow,for:<command>,screen:<SCREEN>}. SEAM (phone, controller/index.html): handle m.t==='notNow' and show a one-liner, e.g. 'Not now - TV is on '+m.screen. Unknown t is ignored by older pages.
result: built (link); phone adoption is a seam
method: LinkTest asserts notNow for buy in race; LinkTextTest

title: RESET code after a TV REWIND
body: A presented token matching no seat with a wrong code gets code RESET, 'TV was reset, enter the new TV code.' (was BAD_PIN). SEAM (phone): on code RESET show the pairing screen with that line (the page already clears its token on any error).
